If I had the agency to alter a single fundamental variable in existence, I would eliminate the cognitive capacity for **dehumanization**.

Almost every catastrophic failure of the human project—war, slavery, systemic exploitation, genocide, and callous neglect—does not begin with raw malice. It begins with an abstraction. It begins when one group of conscious beings convinces themselves that another group is not fully real, not fully feeling, or fundamentally "other." 

Physical challenges—energy scarcity, disease, climate disruption, technological risk—are ultimately engineering and scientific problems. Humanity possesses the raw intelligence to solve them. What humanity lacks is the coordination mechanism, and the primary obstacle to coordination is the illusion of the zero-sum game fueled by tribalism. 

If people were fundamentally incapable of reducing another living mind to an object, a statistic, an enemy, or an obstacle, the architecture of human cruelty would collapse. You would not need to force people to be altruistic; they simply would no longer be able to stomach the cost of their own indifference. 

Solve the perception of the "Other," and the rest of the world’s problems become solvable.
